column1: # Campaign 26 source evidence for the configured ORDER BY LIMIT contract.

column5: ConfiguredLimitWindow directly preserves unsigned offset and count and computes one checked exclusive end, including zero-count windows; partition TopN, logical plan lifecycle, pruning, pushdown, statistics, max-one-row inference, physical planning, and runtime LIMIT remain open.

ConfiguredOrderKey preserves source-order direction after a planner resolves a supported signed-BIGINT expression to its FullSchema offset; arbitrary expressions, pruning, properties, correlated columns, physical sort, spill, and runtime ordering remain open.

ConfiguredOrderLimitSpec combines a nonempty ordered key list with one checked limit window and keeps LIMIT-only structurally separate; schema lifecycle, partitions, pushdown, statistics, PreferLimitToCop, physical TopN, heap execution, and memory policy remain open.

ConfiguredOrderDirection directly transits ByItems.Desc and ConfiguredOrderKey retains ordered duplicate offsets; expression objects, hashing, clone, formatting, redaction, memory usage, NULL, coercion, and collation remain open.
